description: The first cakes: flour, egg and honey mixed, then baked. Three bands behind walls too high to throw over, ovens at the top and mixers at the bottom, joined by a belt down one side and a corridor down the other. Fires break out on the floor.
strategy: The clock waits for the first cake, so chop honey and mix a few batches before serving. Two chefs can ignore the belt and use the corridor; keep someone near the extinguisher in the middle band.
